body.statement: If every \(Q_t\) has replacement sensitivity at most one and \(\mathfrak W_r(Q)\le B\), then \(T_{\mathrm{shell}}\) is pure \(\epsilon\)-differentially private and \[\sup_{P\in\mathcal M_H}\mathbb E_{P^{\otimes n}}d_\Theta(T_{\mathrm{shell}},\theta(P))\le (B+3)r.\] The bound is independent of \(|\mathcal G_r|\) and of every nuisance-sieve cardinality.
body.justification: This proposition turns the formerly informal shell requirement into the exact certificate needed for log-free scalar selection.
body.gap: The exponential mechanism alone gives a global output-cardinality term; the displayed weighted expectation criterion replaces the global union bound with a summable distance-shell calculation.
body.consumer: A full-class construction need only verify one-sensitivity and a uniform bound on \(\mathfrak W_r\) to obtain an \(O(r)\) estimator.
